A productive month ahead, a kind reminder
The subject is crate labels

NOTICE TO TRAVELERS

Travelers must inspect all companion animal crate labels before check-in and confirm that each label is clear, secure, and matched to the correct travel record. This notice is urgent because mismatched or damaged labels can slow release, interrupt handling, and place the animal under avoidable review.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, every case is reviewed in a calm stepwise manner, with the first concern given to identification, then to the condition of the crate, and then to any follow-up needed for the trip. Travelers are expected to keep the label visible on arrival and to report any missing tag, loose fastening, or unreadable mark at once. If a delay affects departure, <<FACT F115>> and the claim note must still be filed with care. The standard remedy is handled separately, and <<FACT F109>> before any further action is recorded.

Please do not wait for a later stop to address an error, because early notice helps Aurelia Skyways protect the animal and keep the record in order. If you are unsure about a label, the desk will review it and guide you through the proper correction without delay.

Report all label concerns at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
